title: Duckling holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 38 Q58 50 55 60' stroke='#e8e8e8' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='26' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='26' rx='13' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='20' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <path d='M64 40 l-3 4 l6 0 z' fill='#e03050'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='19' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#fff18a' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <!-- wing holding string -->
  <path d='M56 64 q8 -2 6 6 q-2 6 -8 4 z' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <path d='M56 64 q8 -2 6 6 q-2 6 -8 4 z' fill='none' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M38 87 l-7 6 l9 -1 l-2 5 l7 -7 z' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <path d='M52 87 l7 6 l-9 -1 l2 5 l-7 -7 z' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='50' r='16' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='50' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#fff18a' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#ffa8b8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='47' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <circle cx='38.2' cy='46.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='49.2' cy='46.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M40 55 q5 -3 10 0 q-5 6 -10 0 z' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <path d='M40 55 q5 5 10 0' stroke='#ffbf5c' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
</svg>
